info.name: BC Dentistry EDR - Web and Mobile APIs
info.description:
Source-derived Postman collection for the clean release branch.

The Web and Mobile trees intentionally duplicate overlapping routes so each team can export or use its own folder independently.

Mobile request descriptions explain purpose, authorization/identity constraints, and side effects, including the implemented rotating refresh-token lifecycle.

Use non-production test accounts and never commit real passwords, JWTs, refresh tokens, patient data, or push tokens into this collection.

item.name: Web
item.description: APIs invoked by the React web frontend.

request.description: Authenticates a web user and returns a short-lived JWT plus the user profile. The test script stores the JWT and identity values as collection variables.

Revokes one session owned by the current user.
Requires the current password and revokes every active session for the user.
Changes the authenticated user password. Required for accounts flagged mustChangePassword; returns a replacement JWT.

item.name: Mobile
item.description: APIs invoked by the Expo patient mobile app, plus clearly labeled required session-contract gaps.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Authentication calls used or required by the patient mobile app.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Authenticate a patient and obtain the JWT required by every protected mobile API.

**Current behavior:** Returns `{ token, user }`. The app rejects non-patient users after login. The test script stores the JWT and patient blockchain ID as collection variables.

**Lifecycle note:** The current app keeps this token only in React state; secure persistence/session restoration is not yet implemented.

item.name: Appointments
item.description: Read-only appointment data shown on the patient home screen.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Show the signed-in patient’s upcoming or past appointments.

**How it is scoped:** The backend derives the patient from the verified JWT; the mobile app supplies only the `period` filter.

**Query:** Set `appointmentPeriod` to the UI period value, typically `upcoming` or `past`.

**Authorization:** Patient bearer token required.

item.name: Data Requests & Consent
item.description: Patient-facing review and control of cross-clinic record-access requests.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Populate Pending, Approved, Rejected, and Documents views with all data-access requests for the signed-in patient.

**Identity rule:** `patientId` must match the blockchain ID in the verified JWT; another patient ID is rejected.

**Authorization:** Patient bearer token required.

**Purpose:** Let the patient approve a clinic-admin-approved request so the requesting doctor can access the specified data for the recorded purpose.

**Effect:** Changes the request to `CONSENT_GRANTED`, writes the decision to Fabric, and can trigger a notification.

**Identity rule:** `patientID` must match the patient blockchain ID in the JWT.

**Purpose:** Let the patient deny a pending data-access request and record the reason.

**Effect:** Changes the workflow status to rejected on Fabric and can notify the requester.

**Identity rule:** `patientID` must match the patient blockchain ID in the JWT.

**Purpose:** Let the patient withdraw previously granted access.

**Effect:** Revokes consent for the selected request on Fabric and notifies relevant actors. This does not delete the underlying health record.

**Identity rule:** `patientID` must match the patient blockchain ID in the JWT.

item.name: Secure Session Lifecycle
item.description: Implemented native session lifecycle. Mobile stores the rotating refresh token in OS-backed SecureStore and keeps the short-lived access token in memory.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Rotate the one-time-use refresh token and obtain a new short-lived access token without asking the patient to sign in again.

**Security behavior:** The submitted refresh token becomes unusable. Reusing it revokes the complete session family. The test script stores the replacement credentials.

**Purpose:** Immediately revoke the current mobile session on the server before SecureStore and in-memory state are cleared.

**Effect:** Previously issued access and refresh credentials for this session are rejected by both APIs.

**Purpose:** Restore and confirm the authoritative patient identity after startup refresh.

**Authorization:** A current mobile access token is required.
**Purpose:** Show active web and mobile sessions so the patient can identify and revoke devices.
**Purpose:** Immediately revoke one session/device owned by the signed-in patient.
